definitions.condition_gate: All displayed arms must have the same five full seed paths complete; incomplete condition tables contain no means/SDs.
definitions.statistics: Arithmetic seed mean and sample SD (ddof=1); no pooling across conditions or experiments.
definitions.speedup: Mean/SD of each seed's baseline fit time divided by its paired comparison fit time; never ratio of mean times.
definitions.pruning: Mean/SD of per-seed rates; contrast is comparison minus baseline in percentage points; D=N-S-V-C.
definitions.times: Reference selection is inside fit/round wall time; do not double count. Independent audit is separate.
definitions.u_component: Fused u screening plus candidate postfiltering plus working-set removal; no isolated working-set effect is claimed.
